This chain implies a potential mechanism where Protriptyline may influence the body's physiological processes, leading to the development or manifestation of Dysthymic Disorder. The integration of these relationships highlights a possible indirect pathway, where the side effect of Protriptyline serves as a mediator in its relationship with the disorder.
